record_title: Conditional q-ary mirror band for linear-code weight distributions
provenance: Scientific sources, proof, originality evidence, and finite verification evidence are documented in RESULT.md and REVIEW.md.
limitations: The q-ary theorem requires a long local gap and can be vacuous; no optimality is claimed for the extra hypothesis or endpoint. The binary theorem remains stronger. Originality is to the best of our knowledge; the motivating preprint is extremely recent, so near-simultaneous or later-revision overlap remains a material risk. No independent validation is asserted.
